decisions.reason: A polymer concrete drain housing with its own page extends the established drainage line at low risk, and one year is too early to judge it below aspiration, so slack supports keeping it.
Floor-level shower drainage is the core of the firm's strategic direction, so a product only mentioned on the site is still kept while its results stay uncertain.
A designer shower drain with its own page fits the firm's design-quality positioning toward architects, and there is no evidence of a shortfall that would trigger search.
A shower element with integrated slope matches the low-profile, integrated-system direction, but its thin web presence makes it somewhat more vulnerable.
The backflow-protected basement drain is actively promoted as a dedicated development, which signals commitment and performance in line with aspiration.
An air-admittance valve is a peripheral but complementary accessory that costs little to carry, so it stays despite its low visibility.
